general_ui_ux_design_guidelines: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute for automated testing.
Never use purely centered, symmetric generic layouts. Use off-canvas alignments and grid tension.
Whitespace is a first-class design element. Use massive paddings (p-16 to p-32) between sections.
Do not use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or any surface that has content under it.

typography.heading: Playfair Display
rules: Use Playfair Display for massive, impactful headlines. Mix regular and italic variants in the same sentence for editorial tension.
Use Manrope for all readable paragraph text. Keep tracking normal and leading relaxed.
Use JetBrains Mono purely for data labels, numbers, axis labels on charts, and supertitles (with tracking-[0.2em] and uppercase).
CRITICAL: Do not use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk anywhere.

accent.description: International Orange. Use highly selectively as the 'Data Ink'. Only for chart highlights, active states, or key CTA buttons.

visual_enhancers.textures: Include a highly subtle, static SVG noise overlay over the entire application to remove digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px sharp borders for structural elements and bento grids. No rounded corners (rounded-none).
visual_enhancers.shadows: No soft drop shadows. If depth is needed, use hard 1px borders combined with a solid color offset shadow (Neo-brutalist hint but strictly corporate).

layouts.grid: Use a 12-column grid. Follow 'Mode A (Tetris)' for projects and 'Mode B (High Density)' for dashboard-like visualizations.
layouts.spacing: Extremely generous. Sections should be separated by py-24 or py-32. Create tension by clustering content tightly in one grid area and leaving adjacent areas completely blank.
layouts.alignment: Strictly left-aligned or grid-aligned text. Avoid center alignment for paragraphs or heavy text.

motion.scrolling: Lenis smooth scrolling is MANDATORY for premium momentum.
motion.reveals: Framer Motion staggered text reveals (line-by-line using overflow-hidden and y-axis translation).
motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on projects should trigger subtle, slow image scaling (1.05x over 0.6s) without breaking the container.

hero.layout: Kinetic, highly asymmetric. Massive 'Playfair Display' typography.
hero.visual: Integrate a subtle 3D moment or an abstract data visualization (using Framer Motion or Recharts) as a floating element that slightly reacts to scroll parallax.

about.features: Numbered manifesto chapters (e.g., '01 / Strategy', '02 / Precision', '03 / Scale').
about.typography: JetBrains Mono for the numbering, Playfair Display for the chapter titles.

skills.visual: Do not just list skills. Create animated, dashboard-style data visuals (Recharts) portraying their proficiency. The charts are the design objects. Style them purely in black, white, and International Orange.

projects.layout: Case studies presented as high-end editorial articles.
projects.features: Include embedded dashboard-style animated charts relevant to the project results.
projects.hover: Hovering the project card changes the cursor or displays a 'View Case Study' button following the mouse.

experience.layout: Minimalist vertical timeline using absolute positioning and a 1px vertical line.
experience.typography: JetBrains Mono for the dates, aligned left. Role and Company in Manrope, aligned right.

marquee.features: One extremely slow, organic editorial marquee separating key sections.
marquee.content: e.g., 'DATA TO DECISIONS — PRECISION AT SCALE — ARCHITECTING INTELLIGENCE'
marquee.styling: JetBrains Mono or Playfair Display, text-xs or text-7xl depending on scale choice, completely sharp and unblurred.

contact.functionality: Working form saving to the backend database.
contact.styling: Corporate and raw. Use HTML standard inputs but styled with Tailwind: rounded-none, border-b-2, border-transparent, focus:border-ink. No standard bounding boxes for inputs.

abstract_data_hero.description: Minimal white abstract wavy lines representing fluid data.

abstract_data_project.description: Abstract white vertical bars resembling a bar chart.

accessibility: Ensure contrast ratios meet APCA standards for the #FF4F00 against white.
Wrap visual charts in semantic sections with aria-labels.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion for all framer-motion animations.
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the pages inside the React application using Tailwind CSS and the specified libraries.
Build the dashboard-style animated charts inside the Skills and Projects sections using Recharts. Apply custom styling so they look like high-end design objects, not default library widgets.
Ensure the hero uses staggered text reveal animations using framer-motion.
Wire up the contact form to save submissions to the FastAPI backend.
Load fonts appropriately in index.css using Google Fonts (@import url).
Do NOT use placeholder image URLs. Use the provided Unsplash URLs in the media section.
Ensure every single interactive element has a data-testid.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT center align the app container in App.css.
Create depth through layout hierarchy, not just shadows. Use 1px borders heavily.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Never use generic AI assistant emoji characters (🤖🧠💡).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Do not use dark colors as gradients. Keep surfaces solid or noise-textured.
